title: Disposable polyethylene floor mats
description: disposable floor mats made of polyethylene plastic sheeting
reference_excerpt: The product in question is a package of six disposable floor mats, specifically marketed as floor toppers and mess mats. These mats are rectangular sheets made from polyethylene plastic sheeting, measuring approximately 38 inches square. They are designed to protect floors and carpets from spills caused by food, paint, and other substances, particularly in areas where children eat or play.

classification.rationale: Heading 3918 covers plastic floor coverings, and polyethylene is a plastic under Chapter 39 Note 1. H290312, which is in force, put a plastic floor mat in 3918.90.10. The mats are polyethylene, so they fall under the other plastics subheading 3918.90. The classification assumes they are not self-adhesive and not made for vehicle interiors.
